limitations: Native Canvas provider, browser-shaped image loader, declared fonts, DOM/events and inert RAF; not Chromium.
Production GameEngine, content.js, mission builder and all render/IK/combat functions are imported; none are reimplemented.
The Cargo image adapter is reused with an explicit repository parameter to read only the selected immutable baseline or isolated candidate.
Fixture placement, deterministic observation time, input selection and resource setup are disclosed; captures are not a complete played mission.
Render-only save comparisons use one fixed wall-clock observation instant so no synthetic Date.now delta is mistaken for save mutation.
The native Legacy resume snapshot synchronizes its actor list; each guard captures that snapshot before its matching physical projection. Initial fixture bookkeeping is not attributed to drawActor.
Anisotropic samples/transforms are recorded and compared with the baseline; native anatomical fitting is not mislabeled as zero observations.
The intended HADAL posture may change muzzle coordinates relative to old airborne art; readiness independence and accepted projectile/render agreement are separate requirements.
conditionNotes: The three motion inputs are native up/released/down commands. Released weighted and magnetic modes drift downward by their native rules; they are not mislabeled as stationary hovering.
Ground samples use real platform geometry. Field medicine is only requested on supported ground; it is not forced into an inadmissible airborne action.
Firing/reloading/medicine/melee must return an accepted native result. A refused request is reported as a failure to prepare that condition, never replaced by synthetic action flags.
The eight image masks mean every subset of the three images, not just one arbitrary 1/3 and 2/3 subset.
Same-clock image loss starts from a successful draw, removes an image without advancing animationTime, and checks that the old draw receipt cannot suppress the native overlay.
All partial masks must match one another. Their corrected common pose is deliberately not required to raster-match the predecessor airborne body.
Out-of-context cases must preserve the predecessor rendering. They also keep the three HADAL images available so refusal is not a side effect of missing files.
additionalLimits: First-frame fixture inputs and accepted actions exercise production rendering; no full chapter traversal or performance claim.
Medical samples distinguish a working service pose from actual completion through update(dt). Cancellation by mere keyboard intent in Legacy remains a separate limitation.
Abyss contains no ladder or vent. Native transit compatibility is owned by the targeted production tests, not fabricated chapter captures.
The three source sheets are original Tantalus designs; canonExact remains false.
The visor ROI is an opaque glass presentation reference, not a visible anatomical mouth. Inclusion in the unchanged probe is checked; exact centre coincidence is not required.
method.metricRounding: Displayed numeric summaries round to 9 decimals; thresholds and original values are preserved in the hashed detailed receipt.
method.assetPaths: Rooted runtime asset URLs are represented as project-relative asset paths in this summary.

detailedEvidence.scope: Full per-draw Canvas trace retained in scratch; this summary preserves all 59 candidate conditions and their metrics.

initialRejectedCandidate.visualFinding: Supported magnetic idle lowered the hips and produced an unintended squat; this candidate was not accepted.
separateHarnessCorrections: The original 1e-6 Canvas readback threshold was below native matrix precision; maximum measured residual 0.000052 px. The declared bound is 0.0001 px; gameplay muzzle coordinates are still compared separately.
The existing Nostromo costume bitmap required awaiting the real native decoder; its first-pass exceptions were in both trees and did not diagnose a game-code defect.

captureResumeState natively synchronizes the Legacy actor list. Taking the physical projection before that snapshot created the first-pass melee delta; ordering the two observations consistently removed it without editing production.

visualReview.scope: Independent visual inspection of all 59 final candidate conditions through actual production rendering and real PNG bytes in native Canvas.
visualReview.rootVisualDecision: Variant 2 and the final two overview sheets were accepted. Supported stance is intentionally flexed; it is not presented as the predecessor pose or a straight-knee stance.
findings: Helmet, collar, shoulder attachments, wrists, pelvis, knees and boots remain visually connected in both orientations; no exposed skin or mixed incomplete kit was observed.
The rifle remains a separate native weapon. Aim, accepted shots, reload and service hands use the actual runtime rig; all nineteen distinct source pieces appear across the matrix.

The supported ready stance keeps a hip offset of +3.949009834 px from the predecessor and knee angle 128.639224382 degrees. Native thigh/shin lengths remain 24 and 23.5 px and sole contacts are unchanged.

Visible height is measured from alpha >=128 in the isolated rendered raster, including the held weapon/service prop. On the selected horizontal-aim samples these do not determine the top or bottom: supported 88 px, ascent 78, released suspension 80, descent 87, service 89.
The helmet has a nominal projected height of 18.5 px. The service pose rotates it uniformly, producing a larger axis-aligned bound; it is not independently stretched.
All partial image subsets retain one complete fallback. Same-clock loss restores the native proxy; all six excluded contexts retain predecessor rasters exactly.
The native medical action is visible while working and returns to the weapon after completion: health 30 to 78, kits 2 to 1 after 2.3 observed simulation seconds, using the native 2.2-second rule.
No further production rendering defect was observed after acceptance of the revised proportions.
limits: Native Canvas with the declared browser API/image/DOM host; no local Chromium, complete chapter playthrough, performance or accessibility certification.
The native 96.5 px standing reference is a rig parameter; it is not mislabeled as the observed visible height or the 42x92 collision box.
Motion samples resolve real up/released/down input and modes at controlled placement. No authored dedicated swimming cycle is provided by this art lot.
Transit compatibility tests preserve native imposed-contact geometry, but these captures do not claim a chapter ladder/vent or certify every painted shoulder in unavailable transit families.
The visor reference is an opaque glass region, not a visible anatomical mouth. Its volume is included in the unchanged oxygen probe; exact centre coincidence is not required.

The 741 candidate transform observations are retained: 559 contextual anatomical fits and 182 existing rendering paths. Six nonuniform source samplings are included in that count; zero warnings is not claimed.
The original rejected squat, rejected small-torso variant and the separate harness corrections remain documented in scratch evidence. No canonical franchise reproduction is certified.
